blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Cusco.

On arrival, you will be met and transferred to your hotel.

In the afternoon, begin a tour of the archaeological sites around the city.

The first stop is **Sacsayhuamán**. The complex was considered a sacred Inca site where, according to legend, people from other tribes were not allowed to enter.

Next, visit **Qorikancha**, the Temple of the Sun. In the 15th century, its interiors were covered in gold and its altar took the form of a golden disc. After the Spanish arrived, part of the complex was destroyed and a monastery was built above it. An earthquake later damaged the Spanish buildings, revealing the massive Inca walls that survived underneath.

Continue to **Tambomachay**, a water temple and site of ritual bathing. Specially built channels fed water into its pools.

Nearby stands **Puka Pukara**, the Red Fortress, which served as a defensive complex.

Return to the hotel after the tour. Overnight in Cusco.

**Optional:** a visit to Cusco Cathedral before the main tour, lasting about **40 minutes**, for a supplement of **$25**.
